CustomField.description: User-supplied name for the assessment run, captured on the "Assessment details" step of the new-assessment flow. Mandatory in the UI/controller; left optional at the metadata level because runs are inserted from async (queueable/batch) contexts where a hard field-required would break DML. Surfaces in the All Assessments list with the auto-number Name as a fallback when blank.
CustomField.label: Run Name
